rounds.summary: Passed with three risks recorded: the containment repeat rule, the unproven 'reads as it did' claim for a literal & < >, and the alphabetical order inside one object. Review round 1 drove all three as findings.

Failed on one defect: the rich_text exception dropped an app's own rich text, not only the Slack client's copy. Pinned by the red test `an app's rich-text words beside a short text of its own`, committed at 0a049686c832 and unmodified since.

Passed: the round 2 failure was fixed. One measured risk recorded rather than failed — the narrowing re-asked its own-words question at every nested rich_text object, 6.014 s at 4,990 levels — with reachability unproven. Review round 2 measured the real bound and the architect required the fix.

Passed: the cost became linear (4,990 levels 0.097 s, the reviewer's 990 KB four-chain shape 0.227 s against its 85.4 s), the duplicate content went, blocks moved before attachments, an attachment's field arrived as one `title: value` line and the two new display names landed. Review round 3 then showed the message-wide repeat set losing a word wherever two cells matched, which round 5 fixes by scoping it and deleting the pairing.
